truthConstruction.labeling: Agent-authored judgments after review of public DOM labels, hrefs, roles, context and CSS visibility. Not human usability evidence.
truthConstruction.order: Initial observation and control review, then expected/accepted/task definitions, then fixture structure checks. EasyWeb classifier and ranker were not opened or loaded by this worker.
truthConstruction.selectedScope: All manually relevant controls within each reduced fixture are listed in accepted; excluded branding, tourism/language, print/copy and non-search feedback input controls remain distractors.
truthConstruction.actionPolicy: Explicit public URLs navigate; JavaScript/popup controls, role-button menu triggers, form controls, calendar event anchors without href and original final-submit controls locate only. Enrollment SSO entry is locate-only to avoid initiating original authentication.

checks: JSON pages and 2 calibration + 1 holdout split per site
all sampled original controls have unique data-eval-id
expected and task source IDs exist in fixture
all expected entries have matching accepted entries
navigate expected href equals browser-resolved original href
fixture tag/href/role equals captured public DOM
all manually relevant reduced controls are accepted
no script elements, inline event handlers or value attributes in fixtures
localStructureValidation.limitations: Temporary structure checker is not a product test; it does not assert classifier accuracy, safe execution or actual task completion.
